basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I'm deeply passionate about digital art and spend most of my free time exploring new design techniques or playing video games. I love dogs and have a golden retriever named Max who accompanies me on my daily jogs. My typical online hours are late evenings to early mornings, thanks to my flexible work schedule. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my love for creativity and adventure.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design from the University of Oregon and have been working professionally for the past 5 years. Most of my knowledge comes from hands-on experience and online courses that keep me updated with the latest trends in digital art.
